messages.subject: Questions about library fGarch
messages.body_plain:
Lords administrators

I wondered if the library fGarch one can use different  independent variables to 
an ARMA model. ie

Y ~ ARMA (1,1) + GARCH (1.1)

but I want

Y ~ x1 + x2 +  x3 + Garch (1.1)

with Y (GDP), x1  (inflation), x2 (S & P), x3 (employment).

 Thanks for the reply

messages.subject: Package 'fPortfolio' & R
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

 

I would like to use R and this package to solve for efficient frontiers on a
group of stocks and/or mutual funds.

 

I'm very familiar with modern portfolio theory and the efficient frontier
and working with quote data.

 

I have never used R before or an R package.

 

I see there is a 63 page manual just for this package, which is
intimidating.

 

How difficult is this going to be to accomplish?

 

How do you suggest I learn just enough R and fPortfolio to get this done?

 

Would I be better off looking for an Excel solution?

 

Thank you.

 

Brooks

 

http://www.r-project.org/

 

 

 

 


	[[alternative HTML version deleted]]

messages.subject: mean.acf?
messages.body_plain:
Hello:


       Does there exist a "mean.acf" in any contributed package that you 
know?  I could not find such but felt a need so created the attached.


       If you think this would be a useful addition to Rmetrics, I can 
add it to, e.g., "fBasics".  However, I felt a need to ask before I did it.


       If you think it should be modified, I can do that.  For example, 
it might be appropriate add a logical argument "weights" indicating 
whether to use a simple average or a weighted average using, e.g, 
(n.used-1) for the weights.


       Best Wishes,
       Spencer
